newsitem.title: GERMANY: Muenchener Hypo says 96 profit up.
newsitem.headline: Muenchener Hypo says 96 profit up.

text.p: Muenchener Hypothekenbank eG said on Thursday that growth in its operating profit and net interest income in 1996 outpaced its balance sheet total, which expanded by 8.6 percent to 27.6 billion marks ($17.3 billion).

The bank said its operating profit after risk provisions rose to just under 70 million marks in 1996 from 62.9 million while net interest income increased to more than 150 million marks from 135.7 million. The 1996 results are provisional.
The bank said new mortgage loan approvals grew by 21 percent to more than 2.6 billion marks, exceeding growth in the overall mortgage market.
Less lucrative local authority loan approvals fell below the 1995 level of just over three billion marks, the bank said.
"Everything suggests that the positive development will continue in 1997," management board member Hans-Ludwig Bungert told a news conference.
Muenchener Hypo concentrates on small-scale financing of residential property, with private mortgages averaging 200,000 marks and business mortgages averaging one million marks.
The bulk of its business is passed onto it by cooperative banks.
